title: ATLAS Lab
intro: At ATLAS Lab, we study how AI can support learning, make reasoning visible, and strengthen the trustworthiness of software and intelligent systems.
about: ATLAS Lab at Penn State brings together research in computing education, human–AI interaction, and trustworthy systems. Our work connects the design of learning technologies with careful study of how people use them, alongside methods for understanding and improving software security.
opportunityIntro: Explore M.S. thesis and undergraduate honors thesis research with ATLAS. We welcome conversations with Penn State students about questions connected to our projects.
inquiryInstructions: Email Dr. Saha with your program and degree, the project or question that interests you, relevant experience, and your intended thesis timeline. You may include a CV and links to previous work.
